== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Frozen Dinner (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Frozen Dinner]]. Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>cb05da1eb5e77fa0a2d25ccebae6d54def9bcf10</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
